subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: GeoCities: Everyone's First Homepage
description: One-minute skill: GeoCities: Everyone's First Homepage.

hook.text: GeoCities gave anyone a free web page, organized into virtual neighborhoods.

buildup.text: Hollywood for entertainment, SiliconValley for tech — pick a theme and start building.

discovery.text: Millions built pages with animated GIFs, guest books, and 'Under Construction' signs.

twist.text: Yahoo bought GeoCities for $3.6 billion, then shut it down in 2009.

climax.text: Archivists saved fragments, but most of the early personal web vanished overnight.

punchline.text: Millions of personal pages vanished in one decision.
